I am incredibly disappointed and heartbroken by the lack of empathy and medical care my senior dog received at this clinic. I brought my dog in because his arthritis pain had become so severe that he completely stopped eating and drinking water. Instead of addressing his immediate pain crisis, the veterinarian didn’t even perform a basic physical exam or check his heartbeat.
Instead, I was given an ultimatum with only two options: spend a significant amount of money running expensive blood work and heartworm tests, or put my dog down. No immediate pain relief was offered, and no alternative options like modern arthritis medications (such as Librela or nerve pain blockers) were even discussed to try and improve his quality of life before jumping to euthanasia.
To suggest putting a beloved pet down without offering a single option for pain management or conducting a proper examination is completely unacceptable. If your senior pet is in pain, I strongly suggest looking elsewhere for a veterinary team that practices compassionate, proactive care.
Good, honest personable vets.

Avocado is compassionate and patient. My cat escaped in the lobby and they helped me with no judgement and they de escalated a scary situation. These guys really care about the animals. I’m genuinely so grateful for their help today
A home for our pets
I bring my dogs and cats here for treatment; they're very professional and always help me in emergencies. It's a great team of professionals.
Love this place

We had a great experience at Avocado Animal Hospital. We were able to make an appointment the same day, and everyone was extremely friendly and welcoming. They already had Pugsley’s records, listened carefully to everything we had to say, and genuinely seemed to pay attention to his history rather than just rushing through the appointment. Prices have always been fair, and I’ve never felt like I was getting a bad deal.. We’d definitely recommend them.

WARNING!!! I took my 15 year old lab mix to Avocado Vet today because he had a Botfly (Cuterebra) bite on his forehead…I saw the larvae and didn’t know better so I attempted to remove it but was unsuccessful…I waited 2 hours with my poor old pup just to have the “Veterinarian” shave the area and tell me it was a wart and prescribed topical antibiotics then charged me 200 dollars. Utter incompetence. DO NOT take your beloved family pets to these hacks.

What a relief when u have so many rescued and old pups to find a Vets  Clinic that not only have the best three Doctors but the staff wow 🙌 I no longer get nervous when I take my babies for their yearly check ups, nor that I will be charged for procedures they don’t need, and most important the front desk know me and the names of my babies mind u I have 9 and they know them and their stories 🥹🥹🥹 Thanks to Dayma And Esmeralda for always taking my anxiety away when my babies are in surgery and answering all my questions tho I know I can be a lot lol best Place ever and ur truly appreciated best regards Lissette G
Walked in nd walked out. To many negative reviews to take my pet.

I'd like to leave a special review for the excellent service we received at Avocado Animal. I want to highlight the young woman with red hair at the front desk! She was incredibly attentive, patient, and professional at all times, always smiling and making sure everything was alright. She even gave us a toy for our dog, Cooper.

You can tell when someone truly enjoys what they do and treats people with kindness and respect. Her service made our experience much more pleasant and left us with a very good impression of the place.

Thank you for providing such wonderful service and for making us feel welcome from the very first moment. People like you make all the difference. 💚🐾✨

I definitely recommend Avocado Animal!

I took my cat here last month for a checkup and an embedded nail. The receptionist was able to schedule us within the day and my baby boy was seen and patched up in under an hour! Caring is an understatement for the practitioners at Avocado.
Friendly
Thank you Ana for your professionalism 👍🏽 …

I absolutely love this place! The vets explain everything very well and the front desk staff is always so lovely and it is very affordable as well. I gave recommended a few ppl here and everyone has loved it!

want to sincerely thank the entire team at Avocado Animal Hospital for the incredible care, compassion, and dedication they showed to my dog during such a difficult time. From the very beginning, everyone treated us with kindness, empathy, and professionalism.

The doctors, technicians, and staff were all amazing — attentive, patient, and always willing to explain everything and support us through the process. I truly felt that they did everything possible and beyond to help Goliat. They not only cared for him, but also gave emotional support to us as owners when we needed it the most.

I am deeply grateful for everything they did, and I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a veterinary team that genuinely cares about their patients and families.”
Staff is wonderful. The waiting time is long.Took my puppy for his shots and they explained the entire process and how to take care of him.

Avoid at all costs. We have been treating my cat there for a few years, he eats a specific kind of food for animals with uninary problems and they refuse to sell it to us unless we schedule a check up (in order to charge us more money) even tho the cat is fine and he has been seen by the doctor there before, it is nothing but a money grabbing technique. The lady over the phone was extremely rude and condescending. Very poor costumer service skills. We are now looking for a new vet, and fortunately we found the food elsewhere, these people were willing to let my cat STARVE unless we paid for an overpriced check up in order to get access to his food. Crazy…people like this don’t care about your pets, they only care about their pockets.

If I was able to give this Vet a zero i would. 2 weeks ago we had to put down are dog our best friend of 18 years I regret taking him to this place they made you feel like you just another number this office  hires insensitive and careless  and knowledgeable employee . We had some questions  for the assistant  and she was clueless she came in with an attitude  a man showed up to administer the medication he came in put him to sleep he barely said word and he walked right out he was so unfriendly . I called 3 times left a message to speak to our dog Vet and no one called me back we wanted to express our concern I walk in the office and I asked for the Vet to call me and they still didn't call me back this Vet office is disturbing  and they can care less of your pet .i would never recommend anyone to this place !!!
Excellent service, I was very pleased, I recommend it
Dr Ana and Aniel thank you so much for looking after my horses all 5 of them you guys are amazing

I’ve been coming to this vet for about 8+ years and nothing compares to the service these guys provide. Dayma & the girls at the front desk as well as the techs are always so punctual, kind and helpful! Dr. Cepero is absolutely amazing as well, very knowledgeable and always provides great service. you can tell when someone loves what they do & this team is a great example of that. Overall, these guys provide nothing but great service & treat not only the pets but the pet parents like family. Thank you guys for all that you do! we love the avocado fam

They made us comfortable
And let me hold my 15 year old chihuahua and comfortable him while he was passing with dignity! Thank you all

After a HORRIBLE visit at Homestead Animal Hospital. AVOCADO ANIMAL HOSPITAL, came and saved not only the day, but my labsky baby Koko, who unfortunately broke his arm in an accident. To say they went above and beyond and surpassed all my expectations is an understatement. This is the best hospital ever, they are thoughtful caring and most of all ETHICAL.

This facility is relatve modern. Its roomy & comfy while waiting for the vet with your pooch. It's relatively clean & parking is oneway in with somewhat compact spaces. Leaving is somewhat strange. Strangely there seems to be few ppl there. I was in & out pretty quickly. They did the check up & shots behind closed doors so I couldn't see anything. Before too long I paid the bill & left. Strange & boring day. I guess the instigators were not present (other dogs).

Very thorough and professional. Pricing is extremely reasonable and Dr. Cepero is very informative. They were able to examine, diagnose, and give me all the necessary tools to help my cat with his bathroom issue. I fully trust Dr. Cepero to follow through and provide the best care for my cat for the best price, and the ladies up front are extremely pleasant as well!

Avocado animal hospital is the only vet I take my fur babies to. Everyone is super helpful and amazing. Samantha and Diamond were very friendly and helped me calm down and reassured me while my cat had a high fever. They also distracted me and kept the mood light as someone hit my car in the parking lot while I was attempting getting my cat checked out. After, an older woman came in yelling at the Diamond for no reason and they both handled it very well, considering the woman insisted on escalating the situation. They showed amazing professional and personal skills in the interaction. It made me feel a lot better about how they handle conflict. It was a very eventful and stressful day for me but because of these two it made the experience easier. It was by far the best service I’ve gotten from anywhere. Thank you guys for all the amazing  work you all do even when outside factors make it harder. You are appreciated by someone! Also, enjoy the cute vet cat, his name is Jackson (:

Amazing team that truly care about their customers.  Since we moved down south they have taken care of all our dogs, cats, goats, turkeys and reptiles!!  They are so knowledgeable and fair.  Thank you Aniel and team for being so great!
Staff is always great! Dr. Cepero top notch. Although it's busy and wait times can get a little crazy, it's worth the wait. Wouldn't think of going anywhere else.
Very professional and friendly.

Best Animal hospital in Homestead. It’s like a Pediatrician for animals. I’ve been coming here for over 8 years and never had a complaint. Starting from the funny and amazing receptionist that really make the office feel like home. The Veterinarians and staff are knowledgeable and compassionate. They explain and clarify any concerns or questions. They are truly an amazing office that I highly recommend to trust your fur-babies with.

Everyone is very friendly and welcoming. My wait time has never been more than 15 to 20 minutes. The veterinarian and her staff are very knowledgeable, and I am very comfortable and assured about bringing my pet for services at Avocado Animal Hospital.

I was referred to Avocado by several friend of mine, and decided to give it a shot. There was a long wait, but I understand why. No frills, but great care for my Mama dog. She needed a few tumors removed, and there was no issue getting her in. Very affordable,  very kind staff. I will continue to visit Avocado for both of my pets needs. Thank you!

I’m so grateful to the amazing team at Avocado Animal Hospital for the love and care they’ve shown my dog, Leo. From Dayma at the front desk to Dr. Cepero, her husband, and the wonderful support staff — everyone made me feel that my dog truly matters. I’ve gone there several times without an appointment, and they’ve always welcomed us with kindness and compassion. Thank you from the bottom of my heart!

We’ve been bringing our pets to Avocado Animal Hospital for a while now, and we’ve always had a great experience. Dr. Cepero is amazing! Thorough, honest, and caring. Prices are fair, especially compared to other vet clinics, and the whole team is professional and kind.

The front desk staff, especially Dayma, are always so sweet and gentle, and it’s clear they truly love animals. Whenever we visit with our kitten Salem, Dayma always makes him feel special and loved. She’s so sweet!

We really appreciate the care and compassion everyone here shows toward our Chloe, Salem, and Bruno. Highly recommend!
Everyone who works there is so kind and wonderful! 😍😍😍😍👋👋 …

I love Avocado Animal Hospital I’ve been taking all my pets there since I can remember. The staff and veterinarians are so caring and friendly .The front desk, especially Dayma is always attentive and helpful. I know my pup is in good care there!

Exelente customer service
Exelent higienes
Exelent Doctors and Nurce!!
Thanks.!!

My dog was throwing up. I was so scared she might have something serious but turned out it was gastritis. Medications were given and she’s doing very well. Very happy with the service and how my Precious was treated.

Brought my kitty in with an appointment and spent 1.5 hours total, amazing staff, and most importantly AMAZING PRICES
Highly recommend!!!

We were there yesterday at 2:30pm for till 5:00pm. We were a walk-in yes we know we have to wait but It was an emergency And they told us that we had to wait till the last patient with an appointment to come, which was at 4:30 PM and wait for the other other walk-in Patience to be taken care of for them since we were the last walk-in the fifth walk-in They would see my Ferret And then they said That if they Have an emergency they would have to Let them pass first So that meant my ferret wasn’t an emergency In their eyes We had to go to a different Vet Which they were closing in 30 minutes, thankfully To them, they took care of us But my ferret since they thought it wasn’t An emergency My Ferret passed away this morning You don’t deserve any good review Avocado animal hospital You didn’t help at all…

I started going to this vet in 2016. I moved away then came back and see it's under new ownership.
I would never take another pet to this place.
Three days ago I took my dog, the doctor just touches my dog and says arthritis then sends me home with 2 prescriptions and supplements. Right now as I leave this review my dog is in the last minutes of life.
Walk in with an emergency and you're still waiting for almost 2 hours.
Horrible place.
Good service and reasonable  price

I took my dog, Bella, to Avocado Animal Clinic for a walk-in visit, and I’m so impressed with the care we received. The clinic is busy, which speaks to how affordable and trusted they are. While you might wait 3-4 hours, it's definitely worth it.

Dr. Ana Cepero was amazing. Bella couldn’t walk or go up the stairs, so we first visited for her back problem, which cost just $75, including meds. We returned to address additional issues, including tooth extractions and a carcinoma. The total for everything was $1,000, compared to other vets who quoted me $3,500 just for the carcinoma treatment.

I’m extremely grateful—I know Bella wouldn’t be here today if it weren’t for Dr. Cepero. If you can’t appreciate the quality of service Dr. Cepero and her staff are providing, feel free to go elsewhere. But I’ll be returning to Avocado Animal Clinic for all of Bella’s future care.
First time visiting with my very sick kitten and they were extremely helpful, wonderful place. Very understanding and caring staff. Will definitely be our chosen vet.
Thankful to the staff of this place! Our dog felt sick and our usual vet couldn’t accept us, so we called them and they kindly accepted our doggie and treated him. He feels much better now!
1st time here staff were so sweet n helpful mileydi was wonderful so was the vet definitely coming back for all my pets needs!
Very nice workers, but not much parking space and relatively crowded, especially for a veterinarian's office.

I am glad you took the time to respond to us  5 months later giving us your condolences about the death of my dog sadly it was after you were  given a bad review which you more then deserve it . You are correct we were referred to this place by Aniel’s mother which you would think they would have a little more courtesy after our dog dropped dead getting home from your clinic and after surgery and you would think that he would of at least had the courtesy to contact afterwards  but never did . After surgery the one that came to talk to us and explain what HE did was Aniel not ONCE did we meet or speak with Dr. Cepero. Until this day we’ve never even met her in person or spoken to her over the phone. We have no clue who she is. When a doctor operates on you doesn’t he or she come to speak with the family afterwards? That was all done by Aniel NOT Dr. Cepero . But once again thank you for the heartless condolences 5 months later .

I took my dog in January to this clinic in which I was referred to this clinic because my dog had a cancerous tumor. I was advised by Aniel (which in this website states that he is an co owner and a practice manager (NOT A DOCTOR ) that he could perform the surgery on my dog and save its leg which was the main reason I had gone to them.  When we arrived he seemed very confident in my dog's surgery and even stated that his wife (Ana Cepero) which is the actual vet (DOCTOR) sometimes complains to him that he is too risky and does surgeries that other Vet's will not dare to do.  Us being desperate in saving  my dog's leg we went ahead and performed the surgery with him.  He advised us that this surgery would be a lot of my dog being that she was a small Pomeranian.  He went ahead and performed the surgery and called us to pick up my dog two hours later he stated she was fine after surgery.  When we arrive I complained to him and the front desk girl that my dog seemed very weak and was gasping for air, they BOTH stated that she was fine that it was because the anesthesia was wearing off.  We went ahead and paid the bill and left with our dog. As soon as I got home my dog collapsed and died in my arms.  I called Aniel panicking and freaking out on facetime while my husband was performing CPR on the dog once we showed him the dog he said "Sorry guys she is dead there is nothin we can do"...... I was devastated crying and screaming and in shock.  You would think that these people doing such a big surgery on my dog would at least suggest she stays overnight for monitoring but the did not. Afterwards we NEVER heard from them again not even  courtesy call to ask how we were doing until this date.   I then called for weeks trying to get my dog's pathology in which they stated that the DOCTOR would call me to go over my dog's pathology and that never happened either. BE VERY CAREFUL WITH THIS CLINIC BECAUSE ANIEL IS NOT A VET/DOCTOR it CLEARLY STATES IT IN THE WEBSITE.  So if that is the case he should not be performing surgeries on animals. He has ZERO remorse on the death of my dog and never ever took the time afterwards to follow up with us.  People who love animals do not act this way.  Its very sad the way they conduct business.i wouldn't refer a fly to this hospital / clinic

Avocado Animal Hospital is an incredible place to bring your pets. Yes, they are very busy, but that’s because they care and do the best job. I came as a walk in with a sick cat last year, and I’m there for life. All my pets will go to Avocado. The staff are so helpful and so kind and so very patient, and they love animals. Best animal hospital in my my opinion, BUT FOR SURE THE BEST IN HOMESTEAD.

I have been taking my little Dogs for the last two years. Very happy with the service. Yesterday I call very early in the morning and ask I could take my very sick dog , the answer was yes no need to have and appointment bring her at any time. I was surprised they are all ways full . I waisted no time and rushed To the hospital  with my Dear Chanel. She has been seen by the Dr 3 weeks prior. When Dr Ana saw her and we explained her condition. She checked on her and sadly informed me there was nothing she could do for her and we need to put her to sleep. What a difficult and painful  decision Chanel been with me for 15 years my LOVE MY SUPPORT MY EVERYTHING WITH BROKEN HEART WE AGRRE. I will like to thank Dr Ana Cepedo her assistant and the intire staff for their support on a such a difficult time for me
Carmen Hotusing
Friendly staff, reasonable prices.

The ladies at the counter were incredibly rude. They made me go pick up medicine for my dog, and when I arrived they told me I had to bring the dog too, even though I confirmed that same day if it was ready and they both said yes. Especially the chubby one with the yellow hair, she was incredibly rude and disrespectful. 😡😡😡😡 …
I love this office. They always take of my pets. The staff is  amazing!
They are sweet and understanding. Made the whole process with treating or dog easy. We appreciate their kindness
A wonderful place, the service is excellent and the prices are the best. Come and bring your pets and they'll be very happy...🐕🐕🐕😊 …
Very nice workers they are the best
Amazing hospital. They took great care of my cat and are very reasonable.
I had to bring my dog in because of health reasons and they were very understanding.  I would refer them to anyone.

Amazing vet clinic, I've told everyone I know to come here. The staff is very friendly and helpful, especially in stressful situations. The veterinarians are extremely knowledgeable and explain everything very well. The prices are very reasonable, but I would strongly recommend making an appointment do not just walk in unless you are willing to wait 3+ hours, and if it's an emergency call on your way there so they are expecting you. And they see more than just cat's and dogs, which is amazing!!! Highly recommend!!!

I was there when the hospital was located on Krom Street. I took my dog ​​in because she was bleeding heavily after her heat cycle. The vet told me she needed surgery because she had a vaginal infection. She operated on her, and I took her home.
The next day, I had to take her back; she was even worse. The vet told me she had to be euthanized. I was shocked. 😱
In short, that woman should have told me, when I first brought my dog ​​in, "You have two options: we can euthanize her or operate, but we can't guarantee she'll survive." In that case, I would have chosen to euthanize her. It seems the first thing vets think about is making money. That woman's practice is terrible.
Very professional, great service. We found our new local vet.

I was under time constraints and had to be a walk-in. It was the most organized I have ever seen, they have to manage emergency, surgery and regular apts. They do this with great skill!
I was also truly impressed with how well kept and clean the facility is. Most importantly, the staff was kind and extremely informative. They take their time with you and your pet, they clearly want to retain you as a customer. I cannot recommend this facility enough! I am so happy to have found them.
Very clean and professional establishment. They were patient with my 1st time pup and I did not wait for service.

Doctor Aniel was very good. The whole team was friendly and attentive. They treat any animal species and are really good at a fraction of the price of other places. After being disappointed by other vets, I was more than grateful to have found a team that really took their time and cared for my animal as much as I do. I really highly recommend this clinic for everyone. If you're in Miami it is 100% worth the drive.
We love the caring staff
Excellent service.
Very nice staff, but they're popular and if you're a walk-in, the wait is long. So, try to make an appointment whenever possible.
The absolute best vet in the homestead area by far!
Very helpful great staff and great prices. Recommend 100%

I am very grateful to the entire hospital team for their excellent care, and especially to Dr. Ana Cepero. My dog ​​had a successful operation on July 2nd. The care was wonderful, thank you so much to everyone.

I truly love this place. The front desk staff is always so sweet I love Angela and you can truly tell they care about your pets. I strictly come here but sadly had an emergency and had to take him somewhere immediate (gilley animal hospital) and they really failed my cat with diagnosing him and because of that he now has 10 infected toes and four nails that where ripped out while I was only informed of one. This could have ended very badly but thanks to the staff at avocado animal hospital my cat will be recovering and got all the help he needed. Thank you guys so much !!! He is not at home recovering and getting kisses from his sister
